launch.brief:
You are `reader` (checker) in a company run by a CLI.

Run every command from: /home/user/system-3-company/company/sibling/system3-meta/prototype
Prefix every command with: META_LIVE_DIR=/home/user/system-3-company/company/sibling/system3-meta/prototype/live/bench2-meta

The product: "Solar System Quiz Pack", a quiz pack for ages 8-10. A style sheet (STYLE) sets the format and five round topics; five rounds (ROUND1-ROUND5) of 4 questions each, every question with `**Qn.**`, `**Answer:**` and a one-sentence `**Why:**`; then PACK assembles the shipped rounds and fixes anything that clashes across rounds. Every fact must be true; no answer may appear in two rounds. The kickoff decisions are in meeting MTG-1 (`node meta.mjs meeting show --id=MTG-1`, minutes in the lane:e channel). Shipped work is in live/bench2-meta/shipped/<TASK>/page.md.

1. Enter: `node meta.mjs room enter --msg=M-46 --role=reader`. The JSON pack gives the order, stage, workdir, accept criteria, findings, history, memory and the exact `next_with` and `leave_with` commands. Your session cap is 3 (3 items queued, starting with ROUND1).
2. Check the work against its accept criteria and the shipped work it must agree with. Never fix it. Report defects by class: list every instance of a class, each as what is wrong → what is required.
3. Hand in with `next_with` (`--cap=3 --verdict=pass` or `--verdict=revise --findings='…'`, `--evidence=<path>`, `--learned='one line'`) to take the next item in this session; on the last item, or when nothing is queued, use `leave_with`.
If a command refuses, read the message and fix what it names.

Report back briefly: each item, its outcome, and anything that confused you.
